title: Simple Coins
description: A lightweight economy module that adds a copper coin, silver coin, gold coin, and wallet system.It is very lightweight, with no fancy colorful coins, no messy extra items, and certainly no configuration files. However, it delivers the essential user exper
body:
An extremely lightweight coin module that provides three types of decimal-based coins and one wallet.
The wallet automatically collects coins, takes them in with the optimal combination, and then returns any excess coins to the inventory.
Even when the wallet is full, it may still continue to store coins, and the combination of coins inside the wallet always adheres to the principle of maximizing value.
It supports the belt slot of the Accessories module.
